notes.title: Super Hiking League feedback improvement collection
notes.content:
This is a major improvements update to Super Hiking League DX! Difficulty balance, better swimming, buffed automatic and mixed ropes, clearer menus, more features in Time Attack mode, select characters in arcade mode and more! 

Check out the full list below:

- Buff to automatic and mixed ropes jump height.
- Increased the flower hitbox. It's now easier to hit the flowers.
- Added descriptions to the game modes on the title screen.
- Adjusted the text time in the intro sequence for better readability.
- Improved the arcade mode difficulty menu to help avoid picking the wrong difficulty.
- More intuitive Time Attack menu functionality.
- Ability to watch several replays simultaneously.
- Ability to adjust replay playback speed.
- Ability to select different Hikers in arcade mode.
- More responsive swimming.
- More responsive jumping out of the water when swimming.
- Less aggressive AI on all difficulty settings except Master.
- Minor accessibility adjustments in the arcade world platforms.
- Tweaked the level design at the end of stage 7 to give the player more options.
- Tweaked the level design in the middle of stage 25 to avoid falling too much.
- The AI will no longer try to attack the player when the player is invincible.

- Fixed Tcheco's knockback frame hitbox by 1 pixel.
- Fixed replay recording that was producing distorted visuals for some characters.
- Fixed the capital S letter by moving it up by 1 pixel.
- Fixed the balloon animation on the credits sequence.
- Fixed the * character on cutscenes that was supposed to be an apostrophe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35811805/889c4ae2c6d5dcefc3d4acc9222b4e57ce84ce7f.png[/img]

notes.title: Super Hiking League DX Update!
notes.content:
The wait is almost over! Super Hiking League DX is coming as an update to Super Hiking League and brings many improvements. Check out the list below!

New major features in Super Hiking League DX:
- Easy difficulty added to Arcade mode!
- Brand new 27 stages, unlockable by completing arcade mode in different difficulty settings!
- 2 new easier rope modes: Automatic and Mixed!
- Watch your own replays or the Hike Master's in Time Attack mode!

Other improvements:
- Fairer AI for the easier difficulty settings.
- Reworked rope bending code.
- Alternate character colors (select with the "start" button or the "enter" key).
- Both players may now select the same character.
- Several other small improvements and fixes.

This major update is set to hit Steam on August 10th, 2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35811805/e3c11e6af01e52bcb780247bf7d82441e7bf9a5d.png[/img]

notes.title: Super Hiking League 1.0.0.2 update!
notes.content:
This update comes with a new small feature for speedrunners: now you can quickly restart on time attack mode! Use down + esc/enter when playing on the keyboard, or down + back/start when playing on the gamepad (please note that some gamepad models may not be compatible).

1.0.0.2 Update Summary:
new feature: added shortcut for quick restart on timeattack mode.

improvement: added a short minimum time for firing the rope multiple times in sequence.
improvement: improved "unlocked text" animation and interaction in Arcade Mode.
improvement: added skippable Arcade mode intro option only after it's been seen at least once (esc/back).

bugfix: fixed bug where in certain conditions you could pick the same character for both players.
bugfix: Master of Combat and Fastest of All achievements now working properly (please beat the AI on Master difficulty on any Stage to activate it if you've already beaten all of them).
bugfix: in rare cases the unlock text would show the wrong message.
